messages:
Ava (People Ops): Quick thread 6#8212; new manager starts Mon. I'm assembling a one-pager "Manager First Week Playbook" (compact checklist + single-page 30/60/90). Need quick thumbs on essentials.

Noah (HR): Please include payroll docs checklist, benefits enrollment links, and a note about manager probation review timeline.

Riley (IT): I'll pre-stage laptop and SSO. Common snag: repo admin perms. If access blocked >2h, ping @Riley + start IT triage via the onboarding bot link. I'll attach the ticket once created.

Sam (Eng Manager): Add a short "What to do in week 0-1" list for managers: set 1:1s, review OKRs, check on-call rota, meet product owner. Also add who signs 30/60/90 (I prefer skip-level).

Ava (People Ops): Draft Week0/Week1 highlights:
- Day -2: Day0 email w/links & ID checklist
- Day 1: Welcome + paperwork (HR), access check (IT), team intros, 30/60/90 sketch
- Days 2-5: 1:1s with directs, review retros & dashboards, shadow incident triage, finalize 30/60/90
- End Week1: share 30/60/90 for skip-level sign-off

Onboarding Bot: Reminders scheduled: Day -2 email, Day 1 agenda 24h prior, Week1 check-in.

Ava (People Ops): Action owners: Riley = access & triage link, Noah = payroll & benefits, Sam = team intros + sample 30/60/90. I'll publish the one-pager here by EOD. Drop any sample 30/60/90s if you have them :slightly_smiling_face:
